news.title: Gianni Infantino is endorsed by the Asian Football Confederation for another term as FIFA president
news.lede: Posted: Oct 23, 2026 / 04:20 AM EDT. Updated: Oct 23, 2026 / 04:27 AM EDT. TOKYO (AP) — The Asian Football Confederation has endorsed Gianni Infantino for another term as FIFA president in an apparent turnaround in its stance from two months ago when it criticized the head of soccer’s world governing body for a breach of trust. AFC president Sheikh Salman bin Ibrahim Al Khalifa, speaking at the body’s extraordinary congress meeting in Tokyo on Friday, embraced Infantino with a large hug in front of the membership as he delivered his endorsement.

news.lede: Gianni Infantino has received a significant boost in his quest for a fourth term as FIFA president after the Asian Football Confederation performed a dramatic U-turn to endorse his leadership. The move comes just months after the AFC joined other continental bodies in a fierce criticism of the Swiss-Italian official over a controversial World Cup investment plan. news.title: Germany sit out FIFA Under-15 World Cup as Russia return
news.lede: Germany is one a handful of FIFA's 211 nations to refuse an invitation to play at the inaugural Under-15 World Cup. The tournament will also mark Russia's return to the FIFA fold. With nearly 1,000 matches and 189 teams, the Under-15 World Cup in Azerbaijan is bloated even by FIFA's usual standards. It marks a change in its attitude to children's international tournaments, which have not existed on anywhere near this scale before.

news.title: Destination America! FIFA confirms the United States will host the inaugural 2028 Women’s Club World Cup as prize money parity edges closer
news.lede: FIFA has officially announced that the United States will play host to the first-ever Women’s Club World Cup in 2028, marking a massive milestone for the professional game. Alongside this landmark hosting decision, the governing body has committed to a significant financial boost for the 2027 Women’s World Cup in Brazil to ensure players and clubs receive greater rewards than ever before. US to stage historic club tournament. The United States will host the inaugural 19-team FIFA Women’s Club World Cup between January 5 and 30, 2028, the governing body confirms.

news.title: FIFA confirms dates for 2027 U-20 World Cup in Uzbekistan and Azerbaijan
news.lede: The FIFA U-20 World Cup 2027, co-hosted by Uzbekistan and Azerbaijan, will take place from September 17 to October 9, with 24 national teams competing for the title. FIFA has opened preliminary registration for fans who want to attend the matches. The dates were confirmed by the Bureau of the FIFA Council on October 22, the Uzbekistan Football Association said. Fans can register their interest through the official FIFA ticketing website to receive updates on ticket sales.

news.title: Hristo Stoichkov and Arsene Wenger back inaugural FIFA U-15 World Cup to transform youth development across the globe
news.lede: Football icons Hristo Stoichkov and Arsene Wenger have thrown their weight behind the inaugural FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival ahead of Saturday's kick-off in Azerbaijan. The newly created international tournament brings more than 3,000 young players, coaches and officials to Baku for six days of meaningful competition across roughly 1,000 matches.
